gloss: winning record; more wins than losses; go-ahead (score)

definitions.gloss: winning record; more wins than losses
definitions.explanation: Having more wins than losses in a series of matches or over a season. Especially prominent in sumo, where achieving 勝ち越し (8 or more wins in a 15-bout tournament) determines a wrestler's ranking.
Scoring the goal or run that puts one's team ahead of the opponent in a game.

examples.japanese: {今場所|こんばしょ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{勝|か}ち{越|こ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: He secured a winning record this tournament.

examples.japanese: 8{勝|しょう}7{敗|はい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ぎりぎり→ぎりぎり：05166_girigiri⟧{勝|か}ち{越|こ}した。
examples.english: He barely got a winning record with 8 wins and 7 losses.

examples.japanese: {新入幕|しんにゅうまく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{勝|か}ち{越|こ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たす→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧で⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: It's not easy to achieve a winning record in your first tournament in the top division.
They scored the go-ahead run in the 9th inning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{後半|こうはん}→後半：12555_kouhan⟧⟦{終了|しゅうりょう}→終了：02563_shuuryou⟧⟦{間際|まぎわ}→間際：14564_magiwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{勝|か}ち{越|こ}し⟦ゴール→ゴール：03845_gooru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: They scored the go-ahead goal just before the end of the second half.

examples.japanese: ⟦{延長戦|えんちょうせん}→延長戦：06540_enchousen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{勝|か}ち{越|こ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ホームラン→ホームラン：20814_hoomuran⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}って→打つ：01221_utsu⟧、⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{勝利|しょうり}→勝利：11795_shouri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{導|みちび}いた→導く：12361_michibiku⟧。
examples.english: He hit a go-ahead home run in extra innings and led the team to victory.

notes:
A sports term with particular significance in sumo wrestling. In sumo, each tournament (⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧) has 15 bouts, and a wrestler who wins 8 or more achieves {勝|か}ち{越|こ}し, which generally results in a promotion in the rankings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {勝|か}ち{越|こ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧: to clinch a winning record
- {勝|か}ち{越|こ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たす→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧: to achieve a winning record
- {勝|か}ち{越|こ}し⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧: go-ahead run/point
- {勝|か}ち{越|こ}し⟦ゴール→ゴール：03845_gooru⟧: go-ahead goal

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {負|ま}け{越|こ}し: losing record; more losses than wins — the counterpart in sumo and other sports
